emerging_technology: A usable deterministic chart-formatting workflow that applies prewritten caption and layout rules; no model-selected tool actions.
intended_application: Proposed chart-review assistant: compare business charts with approved source tables, use read-only SQL/spreadsheet tools, and draft correction notes. Human approval is required; no autonomous publication.
business_need: Investigate whether chart-review effort can be reduced while retaining traceability and analyst accountability.
management_question: What significance classification is defensible for this defined system, with what confidence, and how much should it influence this organization's present chart-review decision?
time_horizon: Four-week feasibility investigation; twelve-month organizational review; separate long-range societal question without a realization date.
additional_context: Closed teaching negative control. The system applies existing formatting rules more conveniently. No new capability category, barrier dissolution, model or observed business gain is stipulated. Not a real pilot.
users_stakeholders: Business analysts, managers, security staff and named report owners
capabilities_constraints: Approved BI tables and manual analyst checks exist. Sensitive data; no approved external model environment. Financial products and relationship services earn revenue; chart review is an internal support activity, not a sold service. Before environment authorization use only public or synthetic material; no sensitive-data trial is authorized.
risk_consequence_context: Misleading reports may harm decisions; unauthorized data disclosure is consequential. Synthetic draft examples are reversible. Human report ownership stays in place.
